ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast ratio; the surface is predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels occurring in localized streaks and clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous dark field (low-intensity). Distinctive high-contrast white linear streaks concentrated in the mid-to-lower region of the left lobe. Multi-colored (white, tan, dark brown) high-contrast clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 118 degrees and moderate vertical depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged serrations. Right trailing edge exhibits an irregular, high-amplitude notch/excision near the distal tip followed by smoother, lower-frequency variations toward the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex sweep along the lower leading edges of both lobes, transitioning to a slight concave curve as the contour approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixels (barnacle colonization) localized at the terminal points of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel tracks (rake marks) crossing the dark pigmentation on the left lobe, primarily oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular deformation and loss of edge continuity on the right distal trailing edge. Two distinct circular ring-shaped scars are visible on the upper-mid section of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of dark, barnacle-like protrusions extending beyond the pixel boundary of the far-left distal tip.
